findings.F1: The next-day reversal depends on how high volatility is. Volatility here is the coin's 20-day volatility over its 60-day average. In the top third, the next day's excess return against the vol-scaled move has slope -0.063 (t -3.89, n 3682), and the signed reversal return averages +0.45% (t 5.19). In the bottom third, the slope is +0.048 (t 1.85) and the reversal return is -0.04% (t -0.47).
findings.F2: In that high-volatility third, nearly all the reversal follows down days. Down days have slope -0.088 (t -2.48, n 1758), while up days have +0.010 (t 0.34, n 1924). The lowest vol-scaled-return quintile is followed by a +1.02% next-day excess return (t 4.96, n 737), while the top quintile gives only -0.19% (t -0.89). So the idea's sign-only down-versus-up check misses a graded rebound after falls.
findings.F3: Saturday's vol-scaled move reverses on Sunday more than any other weekday's move does. Its slope is -0.150 (t -4.89, n 1578), against -0.068 (t -1.83) for Sunday and -0.053 to +0.010 for Tuesday to Friday. The Saturday slope is clearly negative in 2018, 2019, 2022 and 2024 (t -3.9, -4.9, -3.9, -3.8), near zero in 2020, 2021 and 2023, and positive in 2025 (+0.25, t 1.80).
findings.F4: Monday's vol-scaled move tends to continue into Tuesday, with slope +0.081 (t 2.77, n 1578). This is unstable by year: +0.43 in 2018 (t 6.5) and +0.43 in 2019 (t 2.9), but negative from 2022 to 2023. It is not strong enough, given seven weekdays examined, to stand on its own.
findings.F5: Relative volume gives no consistent answer. Within high volatility, low-volume moves reverse more (slope -0.142, t -3.18) than high-volume moves (-0.045, t -1.88). Among all moves with |z|>1, however, the high-volume third reverses most (+0.58%, t 3.37) and the low-volume third less (+0.26%, t 1.99). The brief's low-volume claim is therefore not supported.
findings.F6: The book is only weakly tied to the coins, with a daily correlation of 0.118. Its mean daily return is flat across weekdays, ranging from -0.0002 to +0.0011 with no weekday reaching |t| 2. So the strong Saturday reversal (F3) is not being captured separately by the strategy.

ideas.idea: When a coin's 20-day volatility is high relative to its own 60-day average, a down day is followed by a rise over the next 1 day, and the larger that day's fall measured in its 20-day volatility, the larger the rebound.
ideas.consequence: In elevated volatility, buy after falls in proportion to their vol-scaled size, rather than also shorting after rises, which carry no reversal.
ideas.name: high-vol down-day rebound

ideas.idea: A coin's Saturday (UTC) daily move reverses over the next 1 day, and the larger Saturday's return measured in its 20-day volatility, the larger the move back on Sunday.
ideas.consequence: Fade Saturday's move into Sunday in proportion to its vol-scaled size, a weekend-specific reversal trade separate from weekday fades.
ideas.name: Saturday move reverses Sunday
